items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I used to listen to Tommy Dorsey (ha-ha) quite a bit.

ctx.x: Now, where did you get this idea from, to get all over the horn and move very fast on it? Because the funny thing is, I get the impression that your alto playing was much more fluid than your clarinet playing.
Yeah. Well, I used to listen to Tommy Dorsey (ha-ha) quite a bit. Then another cat in there, (?)Woodie Walder(?)...
